title: Support Bot Rollout and Salesforce Sync Fixes
summary: The team reviewed the support bot, which now answers about sixty percent of tickets, and agreed to roll it out to the Spanish queue. They also discussed nightly timeouts in the Salesforce sync.
decisions: Roll out the support bot to the Spanish queue next, planned for November.
